# [RUN APPENDIX] Coverage, source test and checks, 2026-11-08

## Source test (real calls this run; nothing is claimed as covered without one)
Unattended note: all 29 URLs listed in the task prompt were attempted once through a fetch subagent. Every one returned PROVENANCE_REQUIRED ("permission request not answered in time"); this is a permission-layer timeout, not a 429, robots block or empty result. None were retried or worked around. Registries and regulators were reached through the PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov tools and site-scoped web search (titles and URLs only).

| Source | Result | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| PubMed (MCP) | reached | 11 searches; metadata and abstracts read for 14 records; PMC full text for 1 paper (Lin 2026) |
| ClinicalTrials.gov (MCP) | reached | 3 searches (hyperpigmentation, alopecia); full records read for NCT07618572, NCT07896486, NCT06845540 |
| Europe PMC, Crossref, J-STAGE, KoreaMed, EU Clinical Trials Register (listed URLs) | blocked | PROVENANCE_REQUIRED, one attempt each, no retry |
| EU CTIS, ISRCTN, ANZCTR, UMIN, ChiCTR, CiNii, medRxiv, bioRxiv, SSRN, Google Patents, PMDA (listed URLs) | blocked | PROVENANCE_REQUIRED |
| Health Canada recalls, health-products.canada.ca, FDA recalls, TGA, EU health committees (listed URLs) | blocked | PROVENANCE_REQUIRED. Health Canada recall page titles surfaced through site-scoped search only; dates not read |
| Cosmetics Design Asia/Europe, Premium Beauty News, Olive Young, Hwahae, @cosme, Sephora, Boots (listed URLs) | blocked | PROVENANCE_REQUIRED |
| Web search (standard) | reached | Korean clinic launches (trade and clinic blogs, titles only, nothing opened), Caudalie product search (retail titles, nothing opened), Derm Brief and Lab Muffin searches (no usable recent items) |
| Retailer and brand pages for named products | not opened | No product page was opened this run; ingredient lists and prices are therefore not verified |

## Lane coverage checklist
- HPA axis / nervous system: PubMed searched twice (stress, cortisol, HRV with skin and hair outcomes; stress and sleep trials in acne, psoriasis, atopic dermatitis). Results were mostly off-topic; titles were not triaged beyond the first records. Searched, nothing worth listing; this lane is the thinnest of the run.
- Black and melanin-rich skin: PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov. Entries: niacinamide and bioceramide regimen registry (dossier), Vinoperfect serum registry, oral metformin melasma registry.
- Tools and devices: PubMed (laser, microneedling, RF, ultrasound in Asian skin). Entry: microfocused ultrasound plus 1550 nm laser. A photothermal PRP melasma trial surfaced again and was not relisted (already read last run).
- Clinic and medspa incl. Korean clinics: PubMed plus one web search (titles only). Entry: polynucleotide periorbital review.
- Hair and scalp: PubMed (3 searches) and ClinicalTrials.gov (alopecia). Entries: Ghana traction alopecia survey, CCCA supplement case series (SKIP), split-scalp laser with exosomes.
- Goals-aligned science: topical tranexamic acid dossier.
- Entropy wildcard: tranexamic acid as a possible fine-line ingredient, and the exosome plus laser scalp trial.
- Rx / OTC / clinical: oral metformin registry; chemotherapy-induced alopecia scoping review surfaced and was not listed (off-lane).

## Watch re-check (prior Watch items)
A single combined PubMed query for the previous Watch names returned zero hits, which is not a reliable re-check because the combined Boolean query was malformed. Individual re-searches were not repeated this run. Status: not re-checked individually. Exception: the earlier retinal plus azelaic acid concentrate paper (Int J Cosmet Sci 2026) resurfaced in a search; no new data. The baricitinib CCCA trial (NCT07843732) was not re-opened.

## Limits worth knowing
- Seven of nine entries are abstract-level or registry-level reads. Two dossiers: one full text, one registry record with no results.
- Safety watch comes from search-result titles, not from opened pages.
- The Derm Brief, Lab Muffin and Skin Spectrum Weekly were searched but not fetched; no leads taken from them.

## Build facts
Build printed no Tailwind fallback message and only the line 'built 32 entries'; I did not confirm whether npx compiled or cached CSS was used. RDKit was not installed and was not needed (no ingredient structures this run). Build output: 32 entries total (9 new).
